claims.quote: Newborns should have an evaluation within 3 to 5 days of birth and within 48 to 72 hours after discharge from the hospital to include evaluation for feeding and jaundice. Breastfeeding newborns should receive formal breastfeeding evaluation, and their mothers should receive encouragement and instruction, as recommended in “Policy Statement: Breastfeeding and the Use of Human Milk” (https://doi.org/10.1542/peds.2022-057988).
